chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'a, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: When a man intends divorce, he should divorce her before her waiting period, without sexual intercourse. So if he divorces her once, then leaves her until her term expires, he may — if he so desires — propose along with the other suitors. If he reverts to her before her term expires, or after it, she would be with him upon one (previous) divorce.

If he also divorces her a second time, and desires to propose to her along with the suitors — if he had left her until her term expired — and if he desires to revert to her before her term expires, and he does so, then she is with him upon two (previous) divorces.

If he then divorces her for the third time, she is not permissible for him until she marries another husband. And she inherits from him and he inherits from her, as long as she is in the blood (of menstruation) from the first two divorces.

key_terms.التَّطْلِيقَة: A single divorce pronouncement (tatliqa): in Shia jurisprudence, the triple divorce must be uttered on three separate occasions with intervening conditions
key_terms.الرَّجْعَة: Revocation (raj'a): the husband's right to retract a revocable divorce during the waiting period
key_terms.الطَّلَاق: Divorce (talaq): the Islamic legal dissolution of marriage
key_terms.الْعِدَّة: Waiting period ('iddah): the mandatory period a woman must observe after divorce before remarrying, typically three menstrual cycles

ai.seo_question: What is the procedure for triple divorce (talaq al-sunnah) according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling of Imam Ali (AS), transmitted through Imam al-Sadiq (AS), concerning the proper procedure of the triple-divorce (talaq al-sunnah). The ruling establishes that each revocable divorce must be pronounced outside of sexual intercourse and the waiting period, that after the first and second divorces the husband may retract or re-propose matrimonially, but that after the third divorce the woman becomes absolutely forbidden to him until she completes a genuine marriage to another man. The inheritance rights between the couple are maintained throughout the first two revocable divorces.

en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from Muhammad Bin Ziyad, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When the man intends the divorce, he divorces her before her waiting period, without copulation. So if he divorces her once, then leaves her until she is free from her term, if he so desires to he can propose with the proposers, he can do so. So if he reverts to her before she is free from her term, or after it, she would be with him upon a (previous) divorce.

So if he divorces her for the second (divorce) as well, so if he so desires he can propose to her along with the (other proposers), if he had left her until she was free from her term, so if he so desires to he can revert to her before she has fulfilled her term. So if he does so, so she would be with him upon two (previous) divorces.

So if he divorces her for the third (divorce), so she would not be Permissible for him until she marries another husband, and she would inherit from him and he would inherit her for as long as she was in the blood from the two former divorces’.
en.sarwar: 9. Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hassan ibn Muhammad from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin has said, ‘

If a man decides to divorce he must do so before her waiting period without sexual intercourse. If he divorces once then leaves until her waiting period is complete, he then can be one of those who may propose marriage if he so wills. If he goes back to her before waiting period is complete or afterward, she can live with him after one divorce.

If he divorces a second time also he then proposes marriage as others may do, in case he did not go back before the end of waiting period, if he wants he can go back to her if he so wills before waiting period is complete and if he did then she is with him after two divorces.

If he divorces her for the third time then she is not lawful for him before marriage with another man. She inherits and is inherited if one of them dies as long as she experiences Hayd (menses) after the two first divorces.’”
